title: Decorator
prompt: Need metrics + retries around a PaymentClient without editing its class (vendor). Wrap order debate: Retry(Metrics(client)) vs Metrics(Retry(client)). What do you require?

choices.label: Pick intentionally: decide if metrics should count retries separately
choices.consequence: Wrap order changes semantics; say it aloud.

choices.label: Say order never matters
choices.consequence: It does — retries inflate counts differently.

choices.label: Force deep inheritance instead of wraps
choices.consequence: Fragile when you do not own the type.
